Rebalance.title: Rebalancing Assistant
Rebalance.description: Calculate what to buy, sell, and how much based on the current quarter's target portfolio.
Rebalance.intro: Enter your current holdings, cost basis, number of shares, and remaining cash. The system will calculate the adjustments needed to align your portfolio with the current target allocation. Fractional shares are supported.

results.title: Recommended Rebalancing Actions
results.note: The stop-loss price is estimated using the current quarter's published risk-management rule (approximately -15%). Holdings that are no longer in the target portfolio are recommended for liquidation. This does not indicate a bearish view; it only means the current consensus signal has shifted to other securities. For informational purposes only and not investment advice.
